ecommerce-checkout.name: E-commerce Checkout Redesign
requirements: Shopping cart state persists between page reloads (localStorage or equivalent)
Payment form integrates Stripe Elements — card number, expiry, CVV fields present
Checkout flow is fully responsive on mobile (320px+) and desktop
Order confirmation email is sent automatically after successful payment
Loading/spinner states appear on all async operations (add to cart, checkout button)
Form validation shows inline errors before submission
HTTPS enforced — no mixed content warnings

api-backend.name: REST API Backend
requirements: REST API with at least: GET /users, POST /users, GET /users/:id, PUT /users/:id, DELETE /users/:id
JWT authentication on all protected routes
Request validation with descriptive error messages (400 for bad input)
PostgreSQL database with migrations — no raw SQL string concatenation
Rate limiting: max 100 requests/minute per IP
API documentation available at /docs (Swagger or equivalent)
Unit tests with at least 70% coverage on business logic

landing-page.name: SaaS Landing Page
requirements: Hero section with headline, subheadline, and CTA button above the fold
Features section with at least 3 feature cards
Pricing section with at least 2 tiers, monthly/annual toggle
Email capture form connected to Mailchimp or equivalent
Lighthouse performance score above 90 on mobile
Cookie consent banner present
All links and CTAs are functional — no placeholder hrefs
